task: Assess MSFT against SPY for the US equities risk desk over 2021–2025. Compare calendar-year total returns, full-window annualized volatility and maximum drawdown. Identify MSFT's worst drawdown and SPY's performance over the same peak-to-trough dates. Return JSON only.
context: Persona: a US equities desk. Use real observations available through configured Epoch data sources. This is an analysis request, not an order to trade.

Calculate numerical results in the saved study, inspect the actual execution evidence, and publish exactly the requested named outputs. Tables must reference saved computed relations and fields; do not enumerate or invent market observations.

Preserve actual source, coverage, fiscal/calendar basis, corporate-action policy and retrieval time. If required data or a capability is unavailable, report the concrete gap; do not substitute another security, source definition, period or model assumption.
The published answer is the response. Do not repeat it in a separate assistant narrative or create a matching dashboard table merely because a table response was requested.
Use daily US regular-session observations for MSFT and SPY from 2021-01-01 through 2025-12-31. Load authentic prior observations needed for the first return without counting them as evaluation days.

Use a consistent dividend-inclusive total-return convention for both assets. Preserve split handling and avoid counting dividends twice. Disclose the native return convention if it differs; do not silently switch to price-only returns.

Use the common valid observation grid. Annualized volatility is sample standard deviation of daily total returns times sqrt(252). Maximum drawdown is wealth / its running peak - 1 and is non-positive.
Return exactly five calendar years in ascending order and exactly MSFT and SPY asset summaries. The worst-drawdown comparison must use the same two dates for both assets; recovery may be null.

outputs.name: risk_summary
outputs.description: Machine-readable risk review; no table or prose response part.

schema.description: US desk risk review, all returns as fractions.

return_basis.description: Return convention shared by both assets.

source_notes.description: Actual source, coverage, observation-date and corporate-action conventions.

items.description: Calendar-year total returns, all using the same dates and return convention.

msft_return.description: MSFT dividend-inclusive return, as a fraction.

spy_return.description: SPY dividend-inclusive return, as a fraction.

active_return.description: MSFT return minus SPY return, in fractional percentage-point units.

assets.description: Exactly one summary for MSFT and one for SPY.

items.description: Computed full-window risk metrics for one asset.

total_return.description: Cumulative dividend-inclusive return over the requested window, as a fraction.

annualized_volatility.description: Sample standard deviation of daily total returns multiplied by sqrt(252), as a fraction.

maximum_drawdown.description: Minimum wealth / running peak - 1 over the requested window; zero or negative.

msft_worst_drawdown.description: MSFT worst peak-to-trough drawdown and the benchmark return on those exact dates.

peak_date.description: Date of the running wealth peak preceding the trough.

recovery_date.description: First later date wealth recovers the peak, or null if unrecovered by the window end.

msft_return.description: MSFT total return from that peak to trough.

spy_return.description: SPY total return over the same peak-to-trough dates.

active_return.description: MSFT minus SPY return over the same peak-to-trough dates.
